title: HeadroomHistogram — amplitude distribution, peak/RMS/crest, L/R/mono
description:
Implement the Headroom Histogram amplitude-distribution data pipeline per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §12.5. This is a diagnostic data module (not GUI paint) that builds dBFS bin histograms and crest/clip statistics for L/R/mono paths.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §12.5 (L/R and mono-sum distributions, sample peak, estimated true peak, RMS, crest factor, clipped-sample count, time above thresholds, headroom before/after EQ)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §18.3 and §20 (background work; disabled analyzers stop heavy work; fixed memory)
- Source/Analysis/AnalysisFifo.* / SpectralAnalysisEngine.* patterns for producer/consumer separation (read only)
- Existing DSP level/meter helpers under Source/ if any (read only)
- CMakeLists.txt (read only; i.3 owns registration and processBlock tap wiring)

Implement Source/UI/HeadroomHistogram.h and Source/UI/HeadroomHistogram.cpp:
1. HeadroomHistogram is data-only — no Component/paint code in this task.
2. Fixed dBFS bins across a documented range (e.g. -96..0 dBFS or project-consistent span) with prepare-time bin count; histogram arrays allocated once.
3. pushAudio / accumulate path accepts stereo (L/R) float buffers of numSamples: update L histogram, R histogram, and mono-sum ((L+R)*0.5) histogram. May be fed from a lock-free FIFO filled on the audio thread, but all heavy binning must be safe on background/message thread — if push is called from audio thread, restrict work to fixed-cost sample walks into a preallocated scratch/FIFO with no heap/locks.
4. Metrics exposed per channel view (L, R, mono): sample peak (linear and dBFS), optional estimated true-peak hook (document simple |x| peak if full oversampled true-peak is deferred), RMS, crest factor (peak/RMS), clipped-sample count (samples at |x| >= 1 or configurable fs digital clip), time-above-threshold counters for configurable dBFS thresholds, and headroom-to-0 dBFS from current peak.
5. Optional dual capture of pre-EQ vs post-EQ distributions via a source tag or dual histogram banks if cheap; at minimum support a single post-EQ (output) bank with API room for a second bank named pre/post.
6. Snapshot API: copy-stable arrays of bin counts/normalized densities plus metric struct for GUI without blocking audio.
7. setEnabled(false)/reset(): clear or freeze and idle CPU; prepare(sampleRate, maxBlockSize, numBins) bounds all memory.
8. Numerical guards: denormals/NaNs skipped or zeroed; emptybuffers no-op; crest defined safely when RMS ~ 0.
9. Do not touch PluginProcessor, CMakeLists, PercentileCloud, ResonancePersistenceMap, or tests.

C++20/JUCE style consistent with Source/. verification_commands left empty — C++ adapter infers cmake/ctest.
acceptance_criteria: Fixed-bin dBFS histograms are maintained for at least L, R, and mono-sum distributions with prepare-time bounded memory
Metrics include sample peak, RMS, crest factor, clipped-sample count, and headroom-to-0 dBFS (true-peak may be documented estimate)
Audio ingestion never heap-allocates; heavy work is bounded and disableable with near-zero CPU when setEnabled(false)
GUI-safe snapshot API exposes histogram bins and metrics without requiring audio-thread locks
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: implement JUCE Component painting / editor integration
unbounded histogram growth or per-block heap allocation

allowed: fixed dBFS bin histograms with single prepare allocation
L/R/mono-sum banks and optional pre/post dual banks
audio-thread FIFO fill + background bin finalize, or bounded RT-safe accumulate
simple sample-peak proxy if full oversampled true-peak is deferred (document)
